class.name: IfcSurfaceCurveSweptAreaSolid
class.brief_description: The IfcSurfaceCurveSweptAreaSolid is the result of sweeping an area along a directrix that lies on a reference surface. The swept area is provided by an IfcProfileDef (or subtypes). The profile definition is based on a 2D coordinate system, which is inserted into the XY plane of the 3D Position coordinate system inherited from the supertype IfcSweptAreaSolid . members.member: The curve used to define the sweeping operation. The solid is generated by sweeping the SELF\IfcSweptAreaSolid.SweptArea along the Directrix .
